# istio_remote_cluster_secret (Resource)

Manages an Istio remote cluster secret for multi-cluster service mesh endpoint discovery. Creates a Kubernetes Secret with the `istio/multiCluster: true` label containing a kubeconfig for the remote cluster, equivalent to `istioctl create-remote-secret`. Istiod watches these secrets to discover services on remote clusters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_remote_cluster_secret" "remote" {
  cluster_name  = "remote-cluster"
  server        = "https://remote-cluster.example.com:443"
  ca_cert_base64 = var.remote_ca_cert
  token         = var.remote_cluster_token
  namespace     = "istio-system"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ca_cert_base64` (String) Base64-encoded CA certificate for the remote cluster's API server. Typically from the kubeconfig `certificate-authority-data` field.
- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the remote cluster (e.g. `aks-dev`). Used as the secret data key and in the kubeconfig context.
- `server` (String) Kubernetes API server URL of the remote cluster (e.g. `https://my-cluster.example.com:443`).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token for authenticating to the remote cluster. Create with `kubectl create token -n istio-system istiod --context=<remote> --duration=8760h`.

### Optional

- `namespace` (String) Namespace where the secret is created. Defaults to `istio-system`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/secret-name`.
